checks.name: format
checks.protects: Every code and settings file is laid out the one Prettier way, so a change shows only what it really changes.
checks.misses: Markdown and kit-managed files (left out in .prettierignore), and anything about what the code does.

checks.name: oxlint
checks.run: pnpm exec oxlint -f json . | node kit-lint/hints.mjs
checks.protects: Common bugs and risky patterns Oxlint knows, such as unused variables and unreachable code.
checks.misses: The kit's own rules and plugin rules Oxlint does not support; ESLint runs those.

checks.name: eslint
checks.run: pnpm exec eslint -f json . | node kit-lint/hints.mjs
checks.protects: The kit's own rules (comment ban, no skipped tests, no missing packages) and plugin rules Oxlint lacks.
checks.misses: Rules Oxlint already runs (switched off here so nothing runs twice), and wrong logic.

checks.name: tsc
checks.protects: Values used as the wrong type, missing fields, and calls with the wrong arguments.
checks.misses: Wrong values of the right type, and data from outside the program that is never checked.

checks.name: test
checks.protects: Behavior the tests in src/ describe (parser, key encoding, speech adapters, settings), run by the Node test runner with at most 2 workers.
checks.misses: Behavior no test describes, and tests that pass whatever the code does.

checks.name: pnpm audit
checks.protects: Installed packages with a known security hole.
checks.misses: Holes nobody has reported yet, and needs the network to run.

checks.name: secrets
checks.protects: Passwords, keys, and tokens written into any commit, including old ones.
checks.misses: Secrets in a shape the kit gitleaks settings do not know, and files git does not track.

checks.name: switch-offs
checks.protects: No comment in product code switches off a check, and no file that switches checks off is tracked anywhere.
checks.misses: Rules switched off in the settings files, and code outside productPaths or in notYetClean folders.

checks.name: ratchets
checks.protects: Counts in kit.ratchets.json (switch-offs, useEffect uses, flag groups) never go up.
checks.misses: Whether today's counted uses are right; it only stops new ones.
